blocks.text: Pitt Meadows condos and townhomes: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of condos and townhomes in Pitt Meadows peaked at 82 in May 2026 and bottomed at 38 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in March 2026 with 21. The reported sale price moved from $595,000 to $662,500, a change of +11.3%.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Pitt Meadows?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 66 condos and townhomes listed in Pitt Meadows and 14 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 21%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for condos and townhomes in Pitt Meadows?
faq.a: The September report gave $662,500 for condos and townhomes in Pitt Meadows, against $572,500 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Pitt Meadows?
faq.a: The September report showed 40 days on market for condos and townhomes in Pitt Meadows and a sale-to-list price ratio of 97%, against 28 days the month before.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Pitt Meadows?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: Are townhomes in Pitt Meadows freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
